# dbs-content: content creation diagnosis

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's content-creation diagnosis skill: instead of writing content for the user, it diagnoses a confirmed topic through five dimensions (writing hygiene and "AI smell", cover/title, expression efficiency, cognitive gap vs. peers, AI-assisted workflows), matches the topic to the right form and platform (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, X, WeChat public accounts), and bluntly warns against common traps ("content-before-product", chasing virality over revenue).
